system.description:
Small shields (or bucklers) protect against melee and unarmed attacks only.

Negative Traits: None

Availability: Resources x1, Common

Shields give their user one or more extra Bonus Traits in hand-to-hand combat, adding to the Traits from a melee weapon; the wielder must have at least one level of the Melee Ability. A shield cannot defend against an attack from the rear, and precludes the use of a second weapon or any weapon with the Two-Hand Requirement.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
